contents.text:
This trim requires Minecraft Level VI, Archer Level IV, and Wild completion

It provides +4 Power Levels on all bows, but you also get Weakness I

With a full set you also get the Snipe ability. This ability transforms all spyglasses into snipers. When using the scope, you can shoot any entity by pressing F (to swap between main and offhand) from up to 500 blocks away. You must accurately hit your target but if you do they will take 40 damage. This shot takes a few seconds to reload but there is no additional cooldown. You cannot reload while taking damage.

It can be found in Strongholds

Each Eye piece provides +1 Power Level.
